note: Shasta-Trinity NF campground in mixed conifer and oak on the Upper McCloud River, five miles east of McCloud, the trailhead for the riverside trail to the three McCloud Falls. Paved spurs, bear boxes at some sites. The Forest Service calls it suitable for mid-sized RVs or trailers and does not recommend large RVs. Double sites hold 12 people. --Claude
summary: Fowlers (Shasta-Trinity): $15 ($30 double), 37 sites, rec.gov with 8 first-come sites (03, 08, 11, 17, 24, 28, 32, 36), 14 days, May 15-Oct 15, vault toilets + water. 'Large RVs are not recommended' but mid-sized RVs fit, and every catalog spur posts 28+ ft. Phone empty -> 530-964-2184.
flags: RIG (not a drop): rec.gov says 'Sites are suitable for tents and mid-sized RVs or trailers. Large RVs are not recommended.' This singles out LARGE RVs, not RVs or trailers as a class, and every one of the 36 catalog records permits an RV of 28-59 ft. A 23-ft rig is mid-sized, so the entry is kept. max_rig_ft is left absent rather than reading 59 against that sentence.
PHONE: stored empty -> 530-964-2184 (McCloud Ranger Station; also rec.gov's facility phone).
WEBSITE: the second line, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/shasta-trinity (forest home), -> https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/shasta-trinity/recreation/fowlers-campground. Keep the rec.gov line.
STATUS: FS page shows 'Site Closed', the seasonal closure (season ended Oct 15).
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the sites are on a bench under continuous canopy above the McCloud River canyon, with no water visible near any site point.
SITES: FS says 39 sites (the numbering runs to 39, with 22 absent and doubles 15-16 and 38-39); rec.gov text 35 + 2 doubles = 37, kept.
